description: Registry of MCP servers managed by the agent lifecycle kit.

servers.name: Kit Knowledge
servers.summary: On-demand chunks from the agent lifecycle kit (philosophy sections, SOPs, handovers).

servers.name: Astro Docs
servers.summary: Official Astro documentation MCP for current Astro APIs, islands, and deploy guides.

servers.name: Context7
servers.summary: Up-to-date library docs and code examples for frameworks and packages.

servers.name: GitHub
servers.summary: Issues, PRs, and repository metadata via the GitHub MCP server.

servers.name: Memory
servers.summary: Typed local knowledge-graph memory; create_entities gated by kit ontology allowlist.

servers.name: Linear
servers.summary: Official Linear remote MCP for issues, projects, and status updates (OAuth).

servers.name: Notion
servers.summary: Official Notion remote MCP for specs, PRDs, and workspace docs (OAuth).

servers.name: Slack
servers.summary: Read channels, threads, and post updates via the Slack MCP server.

servers.name: PostgreSQL
servers.summary: Read-only PostgreSQL schema inspection and SQL queries for adapter/data work.

servers.name: Playwright
servers.summary: Browser automation for XFN browser E2E and exploratory UI checks.

servers.name: Chrome DevTools
servers.summary: Official Chrome DevTools MCP for live browser inspection, debugging, and performance analysis.

servers.name: Next.js DevTools
servers.summary: Connects agents to a running Next.js 16+ dev server for routes, errors, and runtime tools.

servers.name: Cloudflare
servers.summary: Official Cloudflare Code Mode MCP (search/execute/docs across the Cloudflare API) via OAuth.

servers.name: Cloudflare Observability
servers.summary: Workers logs, metrics, and invocation search via Cloudflare Observability MCP (OAuth).

servers.name: Sentry
servers.summary: Official Sentry remote MCP for issues, performance, and Seer-assisted RCA (OAuth).

servers.name: Semgrep
servers.summary: Semgrep static analysis MCP for security vulnerability scans during audit.

servers.name: Stripe
servers.summary: Official Stripe remote MCP for Payments API tools and docs search (OAuth).

servers.name: Figma
servers.summary: Figma design context via Framelink stdio MCP (personal access token).

servers.name: Vercel
servers.summary: Official Vercel remote MCP for projects, deployments, and docs (OAuth).

servers.name: LinkedIn
servers.summary: Community LinkedIn MCP for profile reads and posting (OAuth client credentials).

servers.name: Bitwarden
servers.summary: Official Bitwarden MCP for local vault operations via the Bitwarden CLI session.

servers.name: Polyglot
servers.summary: Infinum Polyglot MCP for fetching and creating i18n translation keys across locales.

servers.name: Obsidian
servers.summary: Read, search, and edit Obsidian vault notes via the Local REST API plugin.

servers.name: Raspberry Pi
servers.summary: Remote shell control of a Raspberry Pi (or any Linux SBC) over SSH via ssh-mcp.

servers.name: Warp Factory
servers.summary: Official Warp Factory MCP: list factories, send/continue/complete factory tasks, and onboard a factory via OAuth.

servers.name: PostHog
servers.summary: Official PostHog remote MCP for product analytics, feature flags, error tracking, and HogQL (OAuth).

servers.name: SonarQube
servers.summary: Official SonarQube Cloud-hosted MCP for issues, quality gates, projects, and security hotspots.
